Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines a historical time period with a “time of” phrase; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a group of people in ancient times, so the plural human-group noun is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了：看到了，Here the mother perceives the influence; 看 means “look,” while 看到 means “see/perceive.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个叫孟子的小男孩。他很小的时候，A character’s first appearance should introduce both the name and who the character is, rather than giving only a name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，A habitual action uses the zero particle, not 了, because it describes something that happens repeatedly rather than one completed event. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
6. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。：因为他每天只祭拜，所以他没有朋友。The relationship is cause and effect, so use the paired connector to show that the daily behaviour causes the result. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already expresses a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
This refers to a concrete group of people, so 人们 is required rather than generic 人.
看到 expresses perceiving an influence, whereas 看 means simply to look.
孟子 is first introduced here and should be briefly identified, but the displayed correction ends with the incomplete phrase 他很小的时候，.
老是 describes a habitual action, so it should not take completion 了.
The intended relation is cause and result, correctly expressed by 因为……所以…….
